rows.note: Use it as the all-purpose verb for willingly receiving something, accepting an idea or terms, or finding an offer satisfactory; use 答應 when the focus is agreeing to a proposal or request.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zip3 sau6 nei5 ni1 go3 on1 paai4

rows.note: Use it when accepting means agreeing to a request, proposal, condition, or arrangement.

example.english: If you accept my request this time, don't go back on your word.
example.traditional: 今次你答應我，就唔好再反口。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 daap3 jing3 ngo5 zau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan2 hau2

rows.note: Use it when accept means believing that something is true.

example.english: I accept that what they said is true.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 zan1 ge3

rows.note: Use it when a school, institution, or group takes someone in as a member or participant.

example.english: This school doesn't accept transfer students.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 m4 sau1 caap3 baan1 saang1
